tracking: ADR-0364 S3 (lane E45): API-only by the master brief (2026-11-19); the test-run panel and run view of the Robots detail screen are for the design builder on #453

gaps.POST /v1/robots/:robotId/versions/:versi: runs a robot version once in its robot_browser sandbox with the test secrets, attributed to one of the author's projects with a budget
gaps.GET /v1/robots/:robotId/runs/:runId: reads one robot run (status, failure code, steps, timing) and its evidence list (kind, sha256, size)
